notes_for_editor: One source only. The Forest Lookouts page has three dated notes (FY 1950-51, the 1950s, 1962) and nothing on build date, design, height, status or access. The Central US Lookouts Missouri index lists Meta under Osage County with no status. anyplaceamerica.com returned 403; MDC and Facebook pages in the search results gave no Meta entry. No NHLR Missouri page for Meta in the cache. The story is short for that reason.
